content: Laughter is the sweetest harp music that can ever echo across the hearth of an honest home.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Irish Gaelic Hearth Lore & Bardic Poetry
explanation: You can fill a home with gold, silver, fine tapestries, and imported harps, yet if the atmosphere is poisoned with cold silence, resentment, and tension, it is merely a gilded tomb. The sound of sincere, uninhibited laughter shared among loved ones is the truest luxury on earth.
practicalInsight: Bring humor, warmth, and lighthearted laughter into your conversations with family or friends tonight.
reflectionPrompt: When was the last time your home echoed with uncontrollable, joyful laughter, and how can you invite that warmth back?
